chunks: We called him from the right side of the Mount, and brought him close for communion;

key_terms.الطُّورِ: Mount Sinai, the mountain where Musa received revelation
key_terms.الْأَيْمَنِ: The right side, often denoting honor or a specific direction of call
key_terms.نَجِيًّا: Intimate communion or close conversation, indicating a special, private dialogue with God

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'right side of the Mount' signify in the context of Prophet Musa's call?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Mary underscores the unique spiritual rank of Prophet Musa (AS), distinguishing his direct divine communion (Najiy) as a precursor to the Imams' infallible connection with Allah. The 'right side' of Mount Tur is often interpreted symbolically as the side of divine favor and proximity, reflecting the Ahl al-Bayt's role as the true inheritors of this prophetic light. This intimate dialogue serves as a theological foundation for the concept of Wilayah, where the Imam acts as the perfect vicegerent capable of receiving divine guidance directly.
